title: uv lock update workflow: create automated uv.lock PRs without labels, then add team-review and auto-rerun after a 5-second sleep; existing-PR updates also get auto-rerun
answers: Why does an automated uv.lock PR not get CI reruns?
Where are the labels added on the uv.lock update PR, and in what order?
Why is there a sleep between creating and labeling the uv.lock PR?
body:
Path: .github/workflows/uv.yml, the job step that regenerates uv.lock and opens or updates the automated PR. The new-branch path runs gh pr create, then gh pr edit --add-label, then gh pr merge --auto --squash. The existing-PR path (force-push to the existing branch) runs gh pr edit --body-file, then gh pr edit --add-label auto-rerun, then gh pr merge --auto --squash. Only the new-branch path has the create-then-label delay.
Rule: Create the automated PR with gh pr create without --label, run `sleep 5`, then add team-review and auto-rerun with `gh pr edit "$PR_URL" --add-label team-review --add-label auto-rerun`, and keep gh pr merge --auto --squash after the label. Also add `auto-rerun` with gh pr edit on the existing-PR path, so updated PRs keep the rerun opt-in. The delay separates the PR-open and label events so Protect runs triggered by them do not race and cancel each other under the workflow concurrency group.
Symptom: On automated uv.lock PRs, creation and labeling happened back-to-back, which produced duplicate Protect runs; one run was canceled by concurrency and a successful duplicate appeared on the same PR.
Constraints: This only reduces the race; it does not guarantee Protect avoids cancellation if scheduling is delayed. Do not move the label back into gh pr create. Do not change protect.yml or the existing-PR update path to apply this pattern without checking them separately. The sleep is a timing workaround, not a synchronization primitive. auto-rerun must exist as a repo label before this step runs (see the label note).
applies: Automated uv.lock update PR creation and reuse in .github/workflows/uv.yml; not general PR labeling elsewhere in the repo.
